body:
# Xray -orevision > Xray -orevision Client for Fabric 1.21.1

--- ## Disclaimer Use this mod at your own risk. The developer is not responsible for any server bans or penalties resulting from its use. --- ## Overview Xray -orevision is a high-performance client utility designed to provide clean visual transparency of subterranean blocks, highlighting valuable ores and resources. ## Features | Feature | Description | Technical Layer | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Dynamic X-ray** | Toggleable transparency for all common terrain blocks. | Mixin Injection | | **Integrated Lux** | Built-in lightmap override (Fullbright). | Texture Manager Hook | | **Stealth Engine** | Tricked resource pack acceptance and silent packets. | Protocol Spoofing | ## Getting Started ### Installation If you are new to Minecraft modding, follow these steps to get Xray -orevision running: 1. **Install Fabric**: Download the Fabric Loader and run the installer. 2. **Add Dependencies**: Download the Fabric API and place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder. 3. **Deploy the Mod**: Download the latest Xray -orevision `.jar` file and drop it into the same `mods` folder. ## Tutorial: Your First Mine Once you are in-game, follow this simple workflow to find resources: 1. **Toggle Vision**: Press the X key to activate the X-ray scanner. You will immediately see ores through the ground. --- ## Configuration and Controls | Input | Action | | :--- | :--- | | X | Toggle Visual Scanner | ---
